topic: Travel tools and itinerary analysis improvement concepts
scope: Image mockups only. No app implementation, production data edits, build or deployment.
userRequest: ㅇㅋ 이거좋네 keep 구현전에 한번에 구현하기 위해서 이번엔 여행도구, 일정분석 개선목업만들어야함

assets.finalPrompt: Create a TripLOG “여행 도구” improvement board with three related 390 × 844 mobile screens side by side, total 1218 × 844 CSS pixels. Actual date anchor October 31, 2026; fictional example trip “도쿄 여행 · 11.2–11.6”. Match the existing app's white surfaces, navy #0b1020 Korean Pretendard-like type, yellow #fff05a primary actions, pale blue #bce6fb and pink #f7afc7 accents, crisp outlines, small offset shadows and reusable category icons. Screen “여행 도구”: prioritize a compact packing card “준비물 3/7”, a small progress line, four unchecked items 보조배터리, 상비약, 접이식 우산, 엔화 현금, and a small add/edit control. Below it, concise tools for “오프라인 여행정보” with file-save action, “캘린더 파일 저장”, and a quiet “여행지 시간대 · Asia/Tokyo” row. Do not imply calendar account sync. Screen “준비물”: the same seven-item list, checked 여권, eSIM, 충전기 and the four remaining items, “전체 / 남은 항목” filter and inline add field; no large save button for each check. Screen “오프라인 여행정보”: trip context, choices 일정 checked, 예약번호 checked, 경비 unchecked, a small content preview and one yellow “파일 저장” action with short “HTML 파일로 저장” metadata. Preserve global navigation “개요 · 일정 · 지출 · 리포트 · 설정”, 일정 selected. Keep the composition compact, readable and action-focused. No large cover artwork, reservation-wallet duplication, expense dashboard, weather, nearby search or unrelated new tools.

Create a TripLOG itinerary-analysis mobile board with three related 390 × 844 screens, total 1218 × 844 CSS pixels. Date anchor October 31, 2026; fictional planned trip “도쿄 여행 · 11.2–11.6”. Use white surfaces, navy Korean type, yellow #fff05a selected controls, pale blue #bce6fb stay bars, pink #f7afc7 travel bars, crisp outlines, modest shadows and reusable category icons. View “전체 일정 분석”: compact report tabs 지출 분석/일정 분석, period selector 전체 여행, visible “계획 기준” badge, metrics 계획 일정 34개, 입력된 체류 24시간, 기록된 이동 4시간30분. Show a simple zero-based horizontal stacked comparison “날짜별 체류·이동”: Day1 stay5h/travel1h10, Day2 6h/1h20, Day3 7h/1h, Day4 4h/40m, Day5 2h/20m. Direct-label values and legend; Day2 has separate missing-data markers. Add a compact place-duration ranking with sort control. View “Day 2”: metrics 8개/6시간/1시간20분, sort choices 일정순/긴순/짧은순, rows 메이지신궁2시간, 시부야 스카이1시간30분, 하라주쿠 점심1시간, 리저브 카페45분, 신주쿠 쇼핑30분, 신주쿠 산책15분, 키디랜드 미입력 last. Stay bars exclude lodging; show concise “숙소 제외 · 입력한 시간 합”. View “미입력 항목”: bottom sheet with stay time missing for 키디랜드 and two missing travel segments 리저브 카페→신주쿠 쇼핑 and 신주쿠 쇼핑→키디랜드, each with an input action. Do not represent unknown durations as zero or invent segments. Preserve navigation 개요/일정/지출/리포트/설정, 리포트 selected. No financial dashboard, actual-visit claims, schedule-check menu, automatic rescheduling or narrative recommendations.

Create one TripLOG desktop companion board containing two separate 1440 × 1024 desktop app views side by side, total 2928 × 1024 CSS pixels. Actual date anchor October 31, 2026; fictional planned trip “도쿄 여행 · 11.2–11.6”. Use the existing app's white background, navy #0b1020 Korean typography, yellow #fff05a accents, pale blue #bce6fb and pink #f7afc7, crisp outlines, small shadows and reusable category icons. Each viewport uses the current app's centered approximately 960px content area, compact TripLOG header and familiar five-item bottom navigation, not a new sidebar. Left viewport “여행 도구”: two columns, packing checklist 3/7 on the left with checked 여권/eSIM/충전기 and unchecked 보조배터리/상비약/접이식 우산/엔화 현금, compact edit/add; on the right offline travel-information file saving, calendar-file export and Asia/Tokyo timezone. Do not imply calendar account sync or add unrelated tools. Right viewport “일정 분석”: report tabs, period selector 전체 여행 and visible 계획 기준; metrics 34 planned entries, 24h entered stay, 4h30 recorded travel. Main two-column evidence layout: horizontal zero-based stacked day comparison on the left, compact sortable place-duration ranking on the right. Day labels and stay/travel values: 11.2 월 5h/1h10, 11.3 화 6h/1h20, 11.4 수 7h/1h, 11.5 목 4h/40m, 11.6 금 2h/20m. Use a common linear scale, direct values and legend; separate Day2 missing-data indicators. Ranking examples 메이지신궁2h, 시부야 스카이1h30, 하라주쿠 점심1h, 리저브 카페45m, 신주쿠 쇼핑30m, 신주쿠 산책15m, 키디랜드 미입력 last. Show “숙소 제외 · 입력한 시간 합” quietly. No actual-visit claims, financial charts, automatic rescheduling, decorative artwork or long prose.

notes: The target screen sizes are prompt constraints; they are not a claim of rendered browser verification.
Generated figures, dates, weekdays, amounts, file sizes and visual details are illustrative. Use actual domain data and shared formatters on implementation.
A generated label such as 예상 경비 does not introduce a planned-budget feature. Cost export refers only to recorded expenses.
Unknown durations remain missing, never zero. All duration summaries describe planned, entered times, not actual visits.
Source originals were copied by exact returned paths and both sides compared with SHA256. No newest-file discovery was used.
